title: introduce-historical-bootstrap-interval-gate-for-prompt-stability-ci
author: Priya Nair
release_notes:
- Add a 95% bootstrap-interval CI gate for prompt-set metrics (configurable metric + delta).
- Backfill utility to calculate historical baselines for past windows.
- Integration with smoke-eval CI job and GateRunner so PRs fail only when statistical lower-bound regresses.
description:
Motivation: We frequently see flaky small-sample failures in prompt-set regression checks. Binary pass/fail on single-window averages causes noisy CI and either too many rollbacks or ignored regressions. This PR adds a statistically robust gate that uses bootstrap confidence intervals over a historical baseline window and requires that the lower bound of the candidate run's metric be below an allowed delta compared to the baseline lower bound before failing the CI.

What this changes (high level): Adds a new gate 'historical-bootstrap-interval' implemented as a GateRunner plugin, a metrics helper that computes bootstrap CIs for any scalar eval metric (accuracy, EM, rouge-l, BLEU, custom scorers), a backfill CLI for computing baselines for historical windows, and dashboards to visualize the baseline distribution and CI overlaps. The gate is staleness-aware (weights recent samples higher) and supports an optional progressive rollback/soft-fail mode where a first failure marks the PR with a warning and a second consecutive failure within a configurable window triggers block.

Design notes: - We compute bootstrap percentile intervals (default 95%) using stratified resampling by cohort where cohorts are defined by the existing prompt-set metadata. - Baseline window is configurable (default 30 days) and the backfill tool can populate older windows for teams onboarding the gate. - A candidate run must have its lower CI bound at least `delta` below the baseline lower CI bound to trigger fail. This reduces spurious failures caused by sample noise. - We expose a per-prompt stability score used by progressive rollbacks and to surface hotspots in the UI.

Checklist: - [x] Gate implementation (GateRunner plugin) - [x] Metric utils & bootstrap engine - [x] Backfill script and sanity checks - [x] Unit & integration tests - [x] CI wiring (.github workflow updates) - [x] Documentation and console dashboard JSON - [x] Migration/backfill run recorded in release notes

How to test locally: 1) Run `pytest tests/test_bootstrap_gate.py` for unit coverage. 2) Use `scripts/backfill/bootstrap_backfill.py --start 2025-11-01 --end 2026-01-01 --out /tmp/bootstrap-baseline.json` to generate a baseline and then run `python -m eval_harness.ci_runner --gate historical-bootstrap-interval --baseline /tmp/bootstrap-baseline.json --candidate ./samples/candidate_run.json --report /tmp/report.json`. 3) Example candidate and baseline bundles included under `tests/fixtures/bootstrap/*`.

Rollback & rollout plan: Default gate is disabled. Enable per-repo with `eval_gates.yaml` and start in `soft-fail` mode for 2 weeks. After monitoring, flip to `hard-fail` and enable progressive rollback. Backfill script should be run once per workspace and recorded in project change logs.

Review conversation: 
- Avery Chen (reviewer): "Nice approach — statistical gating is what we've needed. Two quick asks: (1) expose bootstrap sample count via telemetry for post-mortems; (2) add a small example in the docs showing a borderline failure where CILB barely crosses threshold."
- Priya Nair (author): "Added telemetry metric `eval.bootstrap.samples` and extended docs with an example run and visualization. See commit c8d1e57 and docs update."
- Miguel Ortega (reviewer): "Please verify performance on large prompt-sets (100k rows). Any memory caps? Might need streaming resampling or approximate bootstraps."
- Priya Nair: "Added cohort-stratified batching and a streaming-resample fallback when sample > 50k; documented limits and configured default 10k samples for CI runs. See 4f2a6b0 and tests."
- Leah Park (approver): "Tests look thorough, backfill script is safe (idempotent). Approving."
